name: Tidy Starfish 71
author: sekaiking
description: Rounded white button that lifts and glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translateY(-4px) translateX(-2px), box-shadow becomes 2px 5px 0 0 #000000.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Tidy Starfish 71</title>
<style>
/* Tidy Starfish 71 by sekaiking — https://uiverse.io/sekaiking/tidy-starfish-71 */
button {
  background-color: white;
  color: black;
  border-radius: 10em;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 1em 2em;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
  border: 1px solid black;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 black;
}

button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px) translateX(-2px);
  box-shadow: 2px 5px 0 0 black;
};

button:active {
  transform: translateY(2px) translateX(1px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 black;
};
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
    Hover Me
</button>

</body>
</html>
